topics.name: Multimodal Image and Video Retrieval
topics.summary: These methods improve retrieval or captioning by combining visual evidence with text, article context, interaction history, or user clarification, with emphasis on fine-grained content and ambiguous visual intent.

topics.name: Synthetic Media Forensics
topics.summary: These works study detection and evaluation of generated images, singing voices, hybrid text, and other synthetic media, emphasizing cross-generator robustness, structured content, and realistic domain shifts.

topics.name: Vision-Language Representation and Spatial Grounding
topics.summary: The papers improve visual-language representations through token reconstruction, semantic certification, spatially consistent features, panoramic reprojection, and language-directed visual adaptation for grounded perception.

topics.name: Vision-Language Evaluation Benchmarks
topics.summary: These benchmarks diagnose fine-grained recognition, embodied knowledge, structural ambiguity, long-video memory, visual reasoning data quality, and contamination-resistant evaluation of multimodal models.

topics.name: Visual Tool Orchestration
topics.summary: These systems selectively combine OCR, detection, segmentation, language models, and visual reasoning tools to improve accuracy, transparency, and cost efficiency in specialized image-questioning workflows.

topics.name: 3D Gaussian and Neural Scene Reconstruction
topics.summary: The group develops scalable representations for static and dynamic scenes, articulated objects, hands, and editable neural fields using Gaussian splatting, implicit surfaces, learned geometry, and differentiable kinematics.

topics.name: Physical Video Understanding
topics.summary: These studies evaluate or model physical mechanisms in videos and world representations, focusing on causal state changes, multimodal grounding, physically plausible rollouts, and reliable measurement of physical understanding.

topics.name: Video Diffusion Editing and Compositing
topics.summary: The papers use diffusion or flow-based video generation for controllable extension, interaction editing, narrative refinement, spatial blocking, lighting-aware compositing, and multi-object scene consistency.

topics.name: Diffusion Transformers for Non-Autoregressive Generation
topics.summary: These works investigate diffusion-based sequence and multimodal generation, including uniform language models, blockwise reasoning, spectral corrections, parallel region perception, and systematic comparisons with autoregressive systems.

topics.name: Medical Image Segmentation and Quality Assessment
topics.summary: These methods address segmentation, registration, reconstruction, anomaly localization, uncertainty, and image-quality control in MRI, ultrasound, OCT, dermoscopy, vascular imaging, and pelvic imaging.

topics.name: Medical Imaging Diagnosis and Generative Representation
topics.summary: These papers build diagnostic, generative, or multimodal representations for brain, chest, retinal, and pathology images, combining foundation models, clinical metadata, longitudinal structure, and controllable synthesis.

topics.name: Clinical Language and Decision Support
topics.summary: The group evaluates or deploys language-assisted clinical systems for sleep tracking, medical dialogue, appendicitis, diabetes care, delirium, insulin management, clinical extraction, and structured patient prediction.

topics.name: Clinical Speech and Caregiver Analytics
topics.summary: These studies use speech, transcripts, interaction data, and qualitative frameworks to assess cognitive impairment, Parkinsonian symptoms, dementia screening, caregiver needs, and clinician-centered evaluation.

topics.name: Speech Recognition and Multilingual Audio
topics.summary: The papers improve speech recognition and context use across dialects, noisy conditions, Indian languages, and full-duplex interaction, with emphasis on low-resource transfer and self-supervised representations.

topics.name: Audio Enhancement and Synthesis
topics.summary: These works model speech quality, dynamic audio processing, enhancement, timbre transformation, multi-speaker scenes, dysarthric perception, and robust voice editing using perceptual or diffusion objectives.

topics.name: Neuromorphic and Acoustic Sensing
topics.summary: The group develops efficient event-driven or spiking systems for sound localization, fall detection, speech commands, gunshot recognition, BCI decoding, and embedded multimodal perception.

topics.name: Vision-Language-Action Policy Learning
topics.summary: These papers improve robot policies with action chunking, latent world models, residual reinforcement learning, one-step flow matching, memory, safety data, and test-time action selection across simulation and hardware.

topics.name: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Human Videos
topics.summary: These methods convert human demonstrations or unconstrained videos into robot-ready motion, grounding hand-object interaction, embodiment transfer, active perception, and reusable dexterous skills.

topics.name: Tactile and Embodied Sensing
topics.summary: The papers learn robust representations and force or shape estimates from tactile, optical-fiber, continuum-robot, and full-hand sensing, emphasizing missing channels, simulation transfer, and contact geometry.

topics.name: Visual Servoing and Active Grasping
topics.summary: These systems use adaptive visual features, affordance-guided viewpoints, diffusion policies, and deterministic kinematic correction to improve positioning, grasping, and teleoperation under occlusion or perturbation.

topics.name: LiDAR/Radar Localization and SLAM
topics.summary: The group addresses cross-view place recognition, non-repetitive scanning, underwater event SLAM, quadruped sensing, GNSS-aided odometry, visual-inertial consistency, and large-scale semantic geolocation.

topics.name: Navigation and Route Planning
topics.summary: These methods plan efficient motion for robots, vehicles, and UAVs in crowded, partially observed, or dynamically changing environments using occupancy, pedestrian prediction, map priors, and digital twins.

topics.name: Robot Locomotion and Dynamic Control
topics.summary: The papers develop model-based and learning-based control for jumping, terrain adaptation, payload transport, wheeled pedipulation, humanoid estimation, and locomotion over sand or non-inertial ground.

topics.name: Robotic Inspection and Teleoperation
topics.summary: These works combine compliant control, trajectory optimization, operator input, hardware-in-the-loop validation, branch manipulation, failure diagnosis, and formal safety objectives for inspection and field robotics.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
topics.summary: These methods improve language-model reasoning through token-level credit assignment, self-distillation, rubric guidance, graph-structured exploration, selective intervention, and adaptive rollout data generation.

topics.name: LLM Self-Improvement and Test-Time Scaling
topics.summary: These studies examine iterative revision, held-out selection, scientific amnesia, and evolving natural-language artifacts, showing when self-improvement helps and when repeated optimization causes regression.

topics.name: LLM Alignment, Safety, and Bias
topics.summary: The group measures cultural and gender bias, misfired safety behavior, scientific risk awareness, multimodal deception, memorization mitigation, safety reflection, hallucination detection, and semantic attackability.

topics.name: Privacy-Preserving Learning and Unlearning
topics.summary: These papers address private regression, contextual redaction, active privacy extraction, federated confidentiality, model unlearning, and deletion of sensitive graph or intrusion-detection data.

topics.name: Software and Model Security
topics.summary: The methods detect vulnerabilities, prompt injection, malicious model artifacts, platform-triggered backdoors, CAN attacks, cyber-physical failures, and secure-coding drift through static, dynamic, or policy-based analysis.

topics.name: Agent Memory and Human-Agent Interaction
topics.summary: These studies examine shared memory governance, long-horizon embodied memory, user personalization, social correction, deliberation dynamics, emotional simulation, clarification, and trust in interactive agents.

topics.name: Multi-Agent Orchestration and Tool Use
topics.summary: The papers build or evaluate multi-agent planners, tool-using assistants, agent protocols, interactive verification, failure-aware abstention, and structured orchestration for enterprise and robotic workflows.

topics.name: Information Retrieval and LLM Routing
topics.summary: These systems improve multilingual retrieval, sparse and long-document search, reranking, vector indexing, search grounding, and routing among models or adapters under cost and latency constraints.

topics.name: Recommendation and Advertising Systems
topics.summary: The group develops production recommender and bidding systems using sequence modeling, semantic intents, cold-start denoising, multimodal retrieval, soft feature tokens, and hierarchical online adaptation.

topics.name: Structured NLP and Text-to-SQL
topics.summary: These methods improve extraction, table understanding, process-sequence generation, emotion-cause linking, event-time semantics, and SQL generation through structured inference and confidence-aware search.

topics.name: Multilingual and Low-Resource NLP
topics.summary: The papers address pragmatic inference, morphology-aware tokenization, implicit hate, figurative negation, idiom alignment, multilingual summarization, technical notation, and semantic reuse across languages.

topics.name: Handwriting Recognition and OCR
topics.summary: These works create or augment handwriting and OCR resources for Chinese, Urdu, Arabic, Latin, and European Portuguese, emphasizing script structure, annotation quality, and low-resource generalization.

topics.name: LLM Evaluation and Judge Reliability
topics.summary: The studies develop benchmarks and metrics for forecasting, item discrimination, medical reports, slide generation, model routing, pairwise judging, quantization fidelity, and scientific benchmark integrity.

topics.name: Legal AI and Machine-Readable Law
topics.summary: These papers benchmark jurisdiction-specific legal reasoning, model life-cycle litigation tasks, mortgage decisions, and large-scale access to municipal law, highlighting grounding and procedural consistency.

topics.name: Education Technology and Learning Analytics
topics.summary: The group studies AI-supported tutor assessment, curriculum alignment, programming education, learner visualization, avatar tutoring, and interpretable models of student mathematical competence.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting and Retrieval
topics.summary: These methods model streams under drift, missingness, multimodal context, epidemic dynamics, spectral similarity, graph structure, and learned context management for forecasting and stream prediction.

topics.name: Causal Inference and Policy Learning
topics.summary: The papers address domain-shifted fragility, hidden confounding, strategic behavior, counterfactual recourse, causal abstraction, policy learning, and treatment or incentive timing from observational data.

topics.name: Online Decision-Making and Multiobjective Optimization
topics.summary: These works develop bandit, POMDP, reward-machine, preference-based, curiosity-driven, Ising, and Pareto methods for sequential decisions under uncertainty and competing objectives.

topics.name: Statistical Learning Theory and Uncertainty
topics.summary: The group develops generalization bounds, confidence fields, uncertainty measures, factor models, information decomposition, matrix methods, and geometry-aware statistical diagnostics with finite-sample or asymptotic analysis.

topics.name: Data Selection, Clustering, and Combinatorial Search
topics.summary: These methods select informative or diverse data, extract alternative clusterings, prioritize combinatorial search regions, and improve exact or approximate optimization with principled scoring and adaptive allocation.

topics.name: Scientific Machine Learning for Climate and Weather
topics.summary: The papers use neural emulators and post-processing for stratospheric dynamics, numerical weather error, climate scenarios, space weather, electricity markets, and calibrated probabilistic forecasts.

topics.name: Physics-Informed and Engineering Machine Learning
topics.summary: These works combine neural models with physical equations, dynamical structure, graph operators, optical measurements, rotating-system data, and quantum or differentiable simulation for scientific prediction.

topics.name: Molecular, Materials, and Biological Machine Learning
topics.summary: The group applies foundation models, graph networks, agents, spectral prediction, generative modeling, and benchmark analysis to proteins, molecules, materials, plant physiology, mass spectrometry, and manufacturing.

topics.name: Remote Sensing and Geospatial Perception
topics.summary: These papers build multimodal datasets and models for off-road segmentation, landslides, forests, plantations, surfaces, aerial-ground collaboration, and environmental monitoring under domain variation.

topics.name: Astronomical and Spaceborne Sensing
topics.summary: The group develops compact learning and event-based sensing systems for exoplanet transit recovery, X-ray and optical catalog matching, and low-power orbital object detection.

topics.name: Efficient Neural Architectures
topics.summary: These works improve efficiency or scalability through adaptive attention, neural graph substrates, sparse experts, layerwise distillation, frequency-domain tokenization, and accelerator-aware design.

topics.name: Representation Geometry and Interpretability
topics.summary: The papers analyze attention dynamics, spectral geometry, symbolic surrogates, concept bottlenecks, normalization structure, topological change, provenance, and internal representations of neural models.

topics.name: Model Merging and Adapter Composition
topics.summary: These methods preserve task-critical subspaces, predict adapter interference, route adapters semantically, and combine multilingual or expert models through static merging and evolutionary exploration.

topics.name: Formal Verification and Theorem Proving
topics.summary: The group combines symbolic verification, Lean formalization, theorem-proving search, neurosymbolic semantics, process rewards, PLC analysis, and probabilistic policy verification with explicit certificates.

topics.name: Image Restoration and Continuous Reconstruction
topics.summary: These methods improve restoration, inpainting, denoising, and continuous image reconstruction with wavelet or spectral representations, lightweight diffusion backbones, learned shrinkage, and efficient local decoding.

topics.name: Anomaly Detection on Structured Data
topics.summary: The papers detect anomalies in relational databases and irregular multivariate streams by combining attribute and edge reconstruction, latent stochastic dynamics, clustering, and neighborhood-aware confidence.

topics.name: Human-AI and Sociotechnical Systems
topics.summary: These studies examine governance, creative work, social polarization, research accountability, copyright, curriculum discourse, construction documentation, and human attention in AI-mediated institutions.

topics.name: Software Engineering Agents and Developer Interaction
topics.summary: The group studies coding-agent benchmarks, repository evolution, developer interaction styles, agent coordination, program regeneration, and sustained multi-turn software maintenance.

topics.name: Specialized Image Recognition and Detection
topics.summary: These applications evaluate compact visual classifiers for CIFAR images, low-light crowds, surfaces, infrared targets, and composite micrographs, emphasizing feature design, clutter, and deployment-oriented accuracy.

topics.name: Learning-Based Automatic Emergency Braking
topics.summary: These systems use large-scale fleet data and noise-aware annotation to improve rare-event detection for automatic emergency braking. Semi-supervised feedback, class-imbalance handling, and production validation target safer triggers without sacrificing driver comfort.
